items.title: [EXAMPLE] Why erasing a bit costs energy: Maxwell's demon and Landauer's principle
items.creator: Example Explainer
items.description: A story-driven explanation of how a thought experiment about a tiny demon ended up linking entropy and information.
items.why_recommended: Bridges information theory and physics, two of your favourite cross-domain links.
items.connection_to_interests: Unlearning is erasure. Landauer is the physics of erasure.
items.what_i_might_get_from_it: A memorable story you could tell at dinner, and a new angle on what 'forgetting' costs.

cross_domain.connection: Erasing information has a physical cost; unlearning is erasure in a model, so Landauer offers a fresh angle on what forgetting means.
